steps.content: A great power surges from the other end of the shackles, and a light shoots out from your palm. Everywhere it shines, the purple rust begins dissolving and contorting, becoming a force that protects all of you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ouch, my head still hurts so badly. But... the hand that's been pulling at my brain seems to be gone.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Has something happened to the shackles? Chief, you're able to affect the contamination?
Zoya's will has traveled here from the other end of the shackles.
You don't know what Zoya has been through. But a power has been transmitted through the shackles, and you're feeling a determination and will to fight.

options: Zoya is still fighting, so we can't lose either

steps.content: Be it the Black Ring or whatever this is, we must destroy it here!
